summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. Contributors highlighted Spark pull requests to include in the patch and a CVE scan workflow issue that was addressed by a separate PR. Benchmarks show conversion is fast for sequential IDs but slower for random UUID keys, prompting consideration of secondary indexing. Kevin Liu raises the question of whether Iceberg V4 should cease writing new ORC and Avro files due to feature gaps, while still supporting reads for backward compatibility.
